verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payments API and credential platform, not an agent or MCP host, so plugging external MCP servers in to consume their tools is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Visa publishes its own MCP server and agent toolkit for other agents to connect to. That server-side evidence does not make the MCP-client story applicable, so none of it is credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
